platforms._comment: === TRADITIONAL MODE (credentials stored encrypted on disk) ===

devices.name: Edifier S2000 Mark III
devices._comment2: name must match the remote's nickname in the Tapo app. thingName is optional. irKeys = which SOURCE keys become HomeKit inputs (omit = all sources, incl. EQ modes). irButtons = optional Switch tiles, but leave them OFF unless you explicitly want the generic multi-tile layout instead of the native TV input list + speaker controls. irLabels = explicit display-name overrides for ANY key — power, volume, mute, buttons and inputs (auto-case already gives MUTE -> 'Mute', PLAY -> 'Play', LINE1 -> 'Line 1'; only acronyms like OPT/Coax need spelling out, but everything is listed here for clarity).

_comment_secret_request: === ALTERNATIVE: SECRET REQUEST MODE (credentials via iPhone push, never stored on disk) ===

_example_secret_request.name: Tapo Platform
_example_secret_request._note: Devices appear immediately but show 'No Response' until you approve the secret request on your iPhone
_example_secret_request._setup: 1. Run secret-request server (docker-compose up), 2. Store credentials in iOS Keychain via Scriptable, 3. Restart Homebridge and approve push notification
